output.level_0: Point of sale scan lines arrive corrupted, making nightly forecast retraining impossible.
output.level_1: No data versioning exists, so buyers cannot trace which scan lines built a bad allocation.
output.level_2: Data engineers manually snapshot raw till data before retraining, risking human error and delays.
output.level_3: The pipeline automatically tags each nightly data drop with a unique, immutable version identifier.
output.level_4: Data versions are governed, linking every forecast run to auditable consent and retention records.
